judged_text: The handler performs no HTTP-method check and validates the body with appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) with no try/catch or defaultResponder-style error mapping. A parent application whose push sends userId as a string (the natural shape for a form-encoded request), or any request reaching the parse with a non-conforming body, gets an unhandled ZodError and a 500 instead of a 4xx describing the problem; because 5xx responses are retried by convention, one misconfigured payload becomes a retry storm against the webhook with no error contract to debug against.

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does not gate on `req.method` (so e.g. GET/PUT will proceed) and it calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` without any try/catch or a shared error-mapping wrapper (unlike other routes using `defaultHandler/defaultResponder` in this repo). `zod.parse` will throw on non-conforming payloads (e.g. `userId` sent as a string or missing fields), which will bubble up as an unhandled error and typically produce a 500 rather than a 4xx with a useful message.
